recipe.ghg_method: Published GHG total in Gg CO₂eq, using source AR5 GWP100; converted to tonnes without applying GWP twice. CO₂, CH₄, N₂O and F-gases. Residence-based SEEA accounts; LULUCF excluded. Direct final-demand emissions stored separately and included once in Whole economy.
recipe.gdp_note: Basic-price value added plus net product taxes on intermediate and final uses; tax bridge recovered from the original ADB worksheet.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the explicitly listed value-added rows in the source; product taxes and balancing adjustments are excluded.
recipe.attribution: Asian Development Bank: Key Indicators Database Online (https://kidb.adb.org). Accessed on 2026-10-09. Calculations by MARIO; no endorsement by ADB.
recipe.ghg_basis: SEEA residence-based producer and direct final-demand accounts; AR5 GWP100; excludes LULUCF
recipe.ghg_note: ADB: source AR5 GWP100 totals are converted from Gg to tonnes once. SEEA uses residence-based accounts; EDGAR uses a territorial boundary.

provenance.reading_scope: Full local MARIO MRIOT parse with calc_all=False. Original VA and tax rows reconciled by country; matching extensions reconciled to source world totals.
provenance.region_note: The version counts individual economies; MARIO region counts also include aggregate regions.

emissions.method: Published GHG | Total by substance, Gg CO2eq, source AR5. No recharacterisation.
source_notes: The data are compiled based on the System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA) framework where greenhouse gases are attributed to a national economy based on the residence of the emitting economic entities.

To facilitate aggregation, emissions are converted to carbon dioxide equivalents using global warming potential (GWP) factors in a 100-year time horizon. GWP factors are obtained from the IPCC (2014) Fifth Assessment Report [AR5].

Agriculture, Forestry, and Other Land Use (AFOLU) includes emissions from rice cultivation, livestock (enteric fermentation), liming and urea application to managed soils, manure management systems. Values exclude emissions from land use and land use changes (LULUCF) or carbon stock changes in managed lands.

IPCC AR5 GWP Values based on IPCC, 2014: Climate Change 2014: Synthesis Report. Contribution of Working Groups I, II and III to the Fifth Assessment Report of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change [Core Writing Team, R.K. Pachauri and L.A. Meyer (eds.)]. IPCC, Geneva, Switzerland, 151 pp.
